extracted.intended_audience: researchers, journal editors, publishers, librarians, and open-science advocates interested in peer review models
extracted.subtask_description: Extraction and definition of distinct traits/dimensions used to characterize 'open peer review' (OPR) as discussed in a systematic review article. Focuses on concrete features (identity disclosure, report publication, participation, interaction, pre-prints, final-version commenting, decoupled platforms).

rubrics_metrics.name: Authors and reviewers are aware of each other’s identity
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors and reviewers are aware of each other’s identity
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclosure of identity between authors and reviewers (i.e., reviewers sign reports and authors' identities are not blinded).

rubrics_metrics.name: Open reports
rubrics_metrics.description: Review reports are published alongside the relevant article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewer reports are made publicly available together with the article (enables transparency of review content and reasoning).

rubrics_metrics.name: Open participation
rubrics_metrics.description: The wider community to able to contribute to the review process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allowing members of the broader community (beyond invited peer reviewers) to contribute comments, reviews, or annotations to manuscripts undergoing review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open interaction
rubrics_metrics.description: Direct reciprocal discussion between author(s) and reviewers, and/or between reviewers, is allowed and encouraged.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Facilitates dialogue and collaborative exchange (e.g., authors responding publicly to reviewer comments; reviewers discussing with one another) rather than one-way anonymous feedback.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open pre-review manuscripts
rubrics_metrics.description: Manuscripts are made immediately available (e.g., via pre-print servers like arXiv) in advance of any formal peer review procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Posting preprints or otherwise making manuscripts publicly accessible prior to formal peer review to enable early feedback and visibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open final-version commenting
rubrics_metrics.description: Review or commenting on final “version of record” publications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enabling reviews or commentary on the officially published, final article (post-publication review/commentary on the version of record).

rubrics_metrics.name: Open platforms (“decoupled review”)
rubrics_metrics.description: Review is facilitated by a different organizational entity than the venue of publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Decoupling the peer review service from the journal/publisher (reviews facilitated by independent platforms or services rather than the publication venue itself).
